items.t: Distributor shaft seizing (stalls or will not start)
items.job: Replace distributor assembly

items.t: Cracked exhaust manifold (3.3L)
items.job: Replace cracked exhaust manifold and gaskets
items.note: Price is per side. Broken studs add time.

items.t: Lower steering shaft joint can corrode (recall)
items.job: Replace lower steering column shaft and joint
items.note: Free under Nissan's recall. Check your VIN or ask a Nissan dealer.

items.t: Coolant leaking into the automatic transmission
items.job: Replace radiator and flush transmission fluid
items.note: Nissan's radiator warranty extension has expired. If the transmission already slips, a rebuild costs much more.

items.t: Timing chain whine (4.0L)
items.job: Replace timing chains, guides and tensioners
items.note: Fix the whine early. If a chain jumps or breaks, engine damage can cost far more.

items.t: Front crash zone sensor corrosion (recall)
items.job: Replace front crash zone sensor
items.note: Free under Nissan's recall or extended sensor warranty. Check your VIN or ask a Nissan dealer.

items.t: Engine control relay can stall the engine (recall)
items.job: Replace engine control relay in the fuse/relay box (IPDM)
items.note: Free under Nissan's recall. Check your VIN or ask a Nissan dealer.

items.t: Fuel gauge reads wrong (sending unit)
items.job: Replace fuel level sending unit
items.note: Some 2006 and 2008 trucks get this part free under a recall; check your VIN first.

items.t: Fuel tank can deform and fool the gauge (recall)
items.job: Replace fuel level sending unit with revised float arm
items.note: Free under Nissan's recall. Check your VIN or ask a Nissan dealer.

items.t: Rear axle seal leaks
items.job: Replace rear axle shaft seal
items.note: Price is per side. Oil-soaked brake shoes or a worn axle bearing add to the cost.

items.t: Steering wheel emblem can come loose (recall)
items.job: Replace driver airbag cover
items.note: Free under Nissan's recall. Check your VIN or ask a Nissan dealer.

items.t: Weak lower control link welds (recall)
items.job: Replace front lower control links
items.note: Free under Nissan's recall. Check your VIN or ask a Nissan dealer.

items.t: Front wheel hubs may crack on 2WD trucks (recall)
items.job: Replace both front wheel hub assemblies
items.note: Free under Nissan's recall. Check your VIN or ask a Nissan dealer.

items.t: Backward circuit breaker can short the wiring (recall)
items.job: Check and reinstall circuit breaker correctly
items.note: Free under Nissan's recall. Check your VIN or ask a Nissan dealer.

items.t: Starter wiring can short on the heat shield (recall)
items.job: Inspect and reposition starter wire harness
items.note: Free under Nissan's recall. Check your VIN or ask a Nissan dealer.

items.t: Ignition can slip out of Run and stall (recall)
items.job: Replace ignition switch
items.note: Free under Nissan's recall. Check your VIN or ask a Nissan dealer. Keep heavy items off your key ring.

items.t: Rear camera image can be switched off (recall)
items.job: Update backup camera software
items.note: Free software update under Nissan's recall. Check your VIN or ask a Nissan dealer.

items.t: Park may not engage and the truck can roll away (recall)
items.job: Replace parking pawl pin and reprogram transmission module
items.note: Free under Nissan's recalls. Check your VIN or ask a Nissan dealer. Use the parking brake until it is fixed.

items.t: Rough or erratic shifting (9-speed automatic)
items.job: Reprogram transmission and engine control modules
items.note: Often covered by the powertrain warranty on newer trucks. If the valve body or transmission is replaced, expect much more.

items.t: Tire inner bead can tear (recall)
items.job: Replace all four tires
items.note: Free under Nissan's tire recall. Check your VIN or ask a Nissan dealer.

items.t: Front lower ball joint can corrode and separate (recall)
items.job: Replace front right lower link with ball joint
items.note: Free under Nissan's recall. Check your VIN or ask a Nissan dealer. An alignment may be needed.

items.t: Backup camera may show a blank screen (recall)
items.job: Update center display software
items.note: Free software update under Nissan's recall. Check your VIN or ask a Nissan dealer.

items.t: Daytime running lights dim after auto stop-start (recall)
items.job: Update engine control module software
items.note: Free software update under Nissan's recall. Check your VIN or ask a Nissan dealer.

items.t: Door striker welds can break (recall)
items.job: Replace door strikers
items.note: Free under Nissan's door striker recall. Check your VIN or ask a Nissan dealer.

items.t: Shifter can come out of Park with the key removed (recall)
items.job: Replace shift interlock pin and lock plate
items.note: Free under recall 98V064. Check the VIN first.

items.t: Front seat belt webbing can be cut by the recliner handle (recall)
items.job: Replace front seat belt assembly
items.note: Free under recall 98V065. Check the VIN first.

items.t: Tail lamp bulb can fall out of its socket (recall)
items.job: Replace tail lamp bulb socket or lamp assembly
items.note: Free under recall 99V347. Check the VIN first.

items.t: Fuel pump wiring terminal can crack and corrode (recall)
items.job: Replace in-tank fuel pump assembly
items.note: Free under recall 04V230. Check the VIN first.

items.t: Shift cable lock plate can break (recall)
items.job: Replace shift cable lock plate
items.note: Free under recall 00V288. Check the VIN first.

items.t: Fuel can spill from the filler neck valve (recall)
items.job: Replace fuel filler inlet shutter valve
items.note: Free under recall 02V300. Check the VIN first.

items.t: Water in the rear axle can ruin the wheel bearings (recall)
items.job: Reseal sensor and replace rear wheel bearings
items.note: Free under recall 02V299. Check the VIN first.

items.t: Supercharged engine can drop into a low power mode (recall)
items.job: Reprogram engine control module
items.note: Free under recall 02V298. Check the VIN first.

items.t: Oil cooler bolts can break and leak oil (recall)
items.job: Replace oil cooler bolts and gasket
items.note: Free under recall 11V592. Check the VIN first.

items.t: Rear seat belt anchor bolt may not hold (recall)
items.job: Replace rear seat belt anchor nut and bolt
items.note: Free under recall 14V418. Check the VIN first.

items.t: Left rear seat belt bracket bolts can be loose (recall)
items.job: Inspect and torque rear seat belt bracket bolts
items.note: Free under recall 21V958. Check the VIN first.

items.t: Missing tow hitch leaves the fuel tank exposed (recall)
items.job: Install tow hitch assembly
items.note: Free under recall 21V917. Check the VIN first.

items.t: Screen reboots and the backup camera goes dark (recall)
items.job: Update infotainment software
items.note: Free under recall 22V772. Check the VIN first.

items.t: Headlight aiming marks missing (recall)
items.job: Replace or re-mark right headlamp assembly
items.note: Free under recall 24V582. Check the VIN first.
